strings.subtitle: — Fail nas korpi —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Oddun soddunk mellona. Sokoilolo button uzar kor.
strings.shred_button: N A S   K O R
strings.ssd_warning:
Xaboddai! SSD ar TRIMak lagun voir boroinncho riti nas korunk garant dienant.
Ho program HDD khatir.
strings.confirm_text:
Fail "{name}" voir boroincho ani kadun uddounk zatolo.

Fuddem voch?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  FAIL VOIR BOROILO ANI KADUN UDDOILO
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS her datastrim (ADS) prosés korunk na.
• USN zornal saaf korunk na.
• Sangkop ani kloud sync
  (OneDrive adi) prabhavit zainant.
strings.status_full: Antargot voir boroilo xunnyan bhorpur. Portun mellonk zainant — aidant xunnyuch disot.
strings.status_fast: Mathe, xevott ani 4 MB patteo voir boroile. Urilo bhag aspotth, punn maddak lagun sadharan aidanim purn portun mellounk zainant. Gupt dastavejank PURN mod uzar kor.
strings.status_empty: Fail rikamo aslo, voir boroinnchem goroz nasli. Kaddun uddoilo.
strings.error_permission: Failak paunk zainant. Her programant ugtt asunk zata. Bond kor ani portun yatn kor.
strings.error_not_found: Fail mellonk na. Adinch kaddun uddoilam zaunk zata.
strings.error_is_symlink: Hem chinnbondh asa. Chinnbondh nas korunk zainant — lakx fail surakshit urto.
strings.error_reparse: Hem zaga fail (OneDrive vo toxench). Tachi mahiti kloudant asa, diskar na — hanga nas korunk kitem na.
strings.error_not_file: Hem fail na (folder vo kitem-ui). Fail sodd.
strings.error_hardlinks: Hea failak her kothin chinnbondh asat ({n} ekun). Kothin chinnbondhank mukhelo na — soglli nanvam soman. Zori soddechea rostean nas korlear, data voir boroilo ani 32 baittak kapot, punn urilo bhag her chinnbondhanim mellonk zata. Adim soglim chinnbondham kaddun udd.
strings.error_compressed:
Fail dabla, gupt kel'lo vo patoll. Xunnyan voir boroinnchem june data nas korunk garant dienant, karon NTFS tacho her torecho sangroh korta.

Gunn kadd: uzvean klik → Gunn → Sudaril'lem → "Dab" ani/vo "Gupt kor" tick kadd. Uprant SHREDDER portun cholo.
